rules.name: Two-handed Melee Weapons
rules.description: A fighter can be equipped with a *held item* and a *two-handed* melee weapon (eg. a Spear and Shield), however, subtract 1 from the Attacks value of the fighter's *two-handed* melee weapons.

rules.name: Two-handed Ranged Weapons
rules.description: A fighter cannot be equipped with a *held item* and a *two-handed* ranged weapon.

sharedRules.name: Arcane
sharedRules.description:
*(Critical hits on 5+)*
Attack rolls made with this weapon score critical hits on a natural roll of 5 or 6.

sharedRules.name: Blast
sharedRules.description:
*(Blast template. Miss scatters d6x2")*
This weapon uses the Blast template.

sharedRules.name: Bludgeon
sharedRules.description:
*(Critical hits deal 1 damage when saved)*
Each time an armour roll successfully saves a critical hit scored by this weapon, the target suffers 1 damage.

sharedRules.name: Brace
sharedRules.description:
*(Initiative vs charging fighters)*
If a fighter uses this weapon while they are the defending fighter, they automatically have the initiative if the attacking fighter charged this activation.

sharedRules.name: Flame
sharedRules.description:
*(Flame template. Auto-hits)*
This weapon uses the Flame template.

sharedRules.name: Guard
sharedRules.description:
*(1 miss can parry a hit)*
When a fighter makes a parry, instead of using a hit they can use a missed attack roll from this weapon. They can do this once each melee attack.

sharedRules.name: Heavy
sharedRules.description:
*(Move or Attack)*
This weapon cannot be used to make an attack if the fighter has made a move during the same activation. In addition, if this weapon has been used to make an attack, the fighter cannot make a move in that same activation.

sharedRules.name: Misfire
sharedRules.description:
*(On a natural 1)*
If any attack rolls for a ranged attack made with this weapon are a natural 1, the weapon misfires. After any other attack rolls have been resolved, make a misfire roll on the table below:
|d6|Misfire Roll|
|:---:|:----|
|1|**Backfire**: The fighter suffers d3 damage. This weapon cannot be used again during this battle.|
|2|**Clogged**: This weapon cannot be used again during this battle.|
|3-6|**Flash-in-the-Pan**: The attack misses as normal.|

sharedRules.name: Natural Weapon
sharedRules.description:
*(Cannot parry)*
Attacks made with this weapon cannot be used to parry.

sharedRules.name: Off-hand
sharedRules.description:
*(Can be used off-hand: 1 attack)*
When making a melee attack, this weapon can be used to make an off-hand attack.

sharedRules.name: One-use
sharedRules.description:
*(1 attack per battle)*
This weapon can only be used once each battle.

sharedRules.name: Poison
sharedRules.description:
*(Critical hits poison. Suffer 1 damage when activated. Until healed or 1 life remains)*
If a fighter suffers damage from a critical hit made with this weapon they become *poisoned*. While a fighter is *poisoned*, each time they are activated they suffer 1 damage. If a fighter is healed, or has 1 life remaining, they are no longer poisoned.
*Demons* and *Undead* fighters cannot become poisoned.

sharedRules.name: Rare (0-[x])
sharedRules.description:
*(Limited by the number listed)*
This trait limits the number of fighters in a warband that can be equipped with this type of weapon at the same time. For example, if a weapon has the Rare 0-1 trait, only 1 fighter in a warband can be equipped with a weapon of this type at any one time.

sharedRules.name: Reload
sharedRules.description:
*(Forgo a Move or Action to reload)*
This weapon begins the battle **loaded**. Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, before it can be used again, the fighter must **reload** it. To reload a weapon, the fighter must forgo either their Move or their Action during their activation. A fighter cannot reload a weapon while engaged in melee.

sharedRules.name: Two-handed
sharedRules.description:
*(1 per fighter. No off-hand attack)*
A fighter can only be equipped with 1 two-handed weapon.
A fighter cannot make off-hand attacks if they are equipped with a two-handed weapon.

sharedRules.name: Unwieldy
sharedRules.description:
*(-1 to attack rolls)*
Subtract 1 from attack rolls made with this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Volley
sharedRules.description:
*(Multiple targets within 3")*
Each time this weapon is used for a ranged attack, it can target a number of enemy fighters equal to its Attacks value. Before resolving any attack rolls, assign each attack to a target. The first target must be picked as normal, each additional attack can be assigned to that target, or to a different visible enemy fighter within 3" of the target that is not engaged in melee.
Then resolve all the attacks.

sharedRules.name: Wrap
sharedRules.description:
*(Cannot parry or be parried)*
Attacks made by this weapon cannot be parried, and they cannot be used to parry another attack.

sharedRules.name: Scare
sharedRules.description:
*(Unengaged fighters pass Willpower test or scatter d6")*
After an attack by this weapon has been resolved, each fighter hit by the attack that is not engaged in melee takes a Willpower test. If they fail, they scatter d6".

sharedRules.name: Item
sharedRules.description: Fighters can be equipped with up to 2 items. These range from shields, to potions, bombs and all sorts of other esoteric equipment. Every item has one or more special rules and a cost in silver.

sharedRules.name: Duellist
sharedRules.description: This fighter can parry critical hits with any successful attack.

sharedRules.name: Sniff 'em Out
sharedRules.description: Enemy fighters that are hidden are not hidden while they are within 9" of this fighter.

sharedRules.name: Seasoned Warrior
sharedRules.description: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

rules.name: Warded Robes
rules.description:
*Armour value 6+*
Roll a dice each time a fighter equipped with this armour is targeted by a spell cast by an enemy fighter. On a 4+, the spell has no effect on this fighter.

rules.name: Full-plate
rules.description:
*Armour value 4+*
Fighters equipped with this armour cannot be equipped with twohanded ranged weapons with the exception of a Brace of Pistols.

rules.name: Shield
rules.description: Improve this fighter's Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

rules.name: Grimoire
rules.description: Once per battle, after this fighter has made casting roll, you can re-roll the casting roll.

rules.name: Dual-weapon Wielder
rules.description: Each time this fighter attacks with an off-hand weapon, they can make 2 attacks with that weapon instead of 1.

rules.name: Fast Learner
rules.description: In the Aftermath sequence of each battle, this fighter earns d6 bonus experience.

rules.name: Great Weapon Master
rules.description: This fighter ignores the ‘Unwieldy’ weapon trait on Melee Weapons.

rules.name: Shooting Drills
rules.description: Each time this fighter reloads a weapon, they can make a Willpower test. If they pass, they do not need to forgo a Move or Action, (see Reload weapon trait).

rules.name: Steady Aim
rules.description: Add 1 to attack rolls for ranged attacks made by this fighter, while this fighter has not moved in the same activation.

rules.name: Tough Bastard
rules.description: Each time this fighter activates while they are **bloodied**, they can take a Willpower test. If they pass, they heal 1 life point and are no longer bloodied.

rules.name: Unshakeable
rules.description: This fighter ignores the Fear special rule and all rules that would make them scatter (eg. the Scare weapon trait).

rules.name: Grappling Hook
rules.description: This fighter can climb high walls in the same manner as ladders.

rules.name: Ensorcelled Bell
rules.description: Once per battle, you can re-roll a **miscast roll** made for this fighter.
